programme: TGIF1, TGFB1I1 (Hic-5), ZNF165 and NR2C2 form a TGF-β/SMAD signalling-amplitude control layer: TGIF1 is a Smad corepressor whose targets include TGFB1 itself and the classic Smad output gene SERPINE1; TGFB1I1 is a TGF-β-induced adapter/coactivator whose targets include TGFB1, BMP4, ID1, CCN2 and VIM (canonical TGF-β/BMP output and EMT genes); ZNF165's entire target set is the three canonical negative-feedback brakes of the pathway — SMAD7, SMURF2, PMEPA1; NR2C2 also targets SMAD7 plus the non-canonical TAK1 arm (TAB1, MAP3K14, MAPK8, MAP2K7) and inflammatory outputs (TNF, IL2, CXCL8). Together they read as a module that both drives (TGFB1I1) and brakes (TGIF1, ZNF165, NR2C2) TGF-β/SMAD signalling output.
role_in_a: Expected role is resetting TGF-β/SMAD signalling amplitude during post-injury lung repair and fibrosis after severe COVID-19, with TGIF1/ZNF165/NR2C2 restraining and TGFB1I1 potentiating Smad output — but none of the four factors have COVID-19-specific literature in the retrieved material, and their Open Targets COVID-19 percentiles are low or absent, so this role is inferred rather than documented here.
role_in_b: Directly reflected in the record: TGIF1 sits within the TGFβ-signalling network described for colorectal cancer (PMID 29986714), TGFB1I1 appears in a chemosensitivity predictive model for colorectal cancer (PMID 23721165), and NR2C2 co-occurs in a rectal adenocarcinoma multi-omics study (PMID 40881169, though that paper's focus is ASCC3, not NR2C2). This fits the well-established broader role of TGF-β/SMAD pathway dysregulation (loss of growth restraint, EMT, chemo/radio-resistance) in colorectal and rectal tumorigenesis.
shared_axis: Both diseases involve epithelial injury states in which TGF-β signalling amplitude must be reset — fibrotic remodelling after COVID-19 lung damage, and pathway subversion during colorectal tumour progression — and the same corepressor/feedback layer (TGIF1 Smad repression, ZNF165-gated SMAD7/SMURF2/PMEPA1 shutoff, TGFB1I1 Smad coactivation, NR2C2's non-canonical TAK1-JNK link) could plausibly be redeployed in both tissues, though no source here documents the two diseases sharing this axis directly.
reasoning: The four factors' target lists independently converge on the same canonical TGF-β negative-feedback effectors (SMAD7, SMURF2, PMEPA1) and output genes (TGFB1, CCN2, ID1, BMP4, SERPINE1), so the programme is a genuine, checkable module rather than a forced label. Rectal-cancer placement is direct for TGIF1 and only circumstantial for TGFB1I1/NR2C2, ZNF165 has no literature at all in either disease, and COVID-19 placement rests entirely on the general biology of post-viral pulmonary fibrosis rather than anything retrieved for these specific factors, keeping the account supported-but-thin rather than strong.
support: PMID 29986714 — links TGIF1 to dysregulated genes/miRNAs in the TGFβ-signalling pathway in colorectal cancer, the most direct hit for this programme; PMID 23721165 — places TGFB1I1 in a predictive model of colorectal cancer chemosensitivity, consistent with a TGF-β-linked treatment-response role but not mechanistic; PMID 40881169 — co-occurs NR2C2 with a rectal adenocarcinoma multi-omics/ASCC3 study, weak circumstantial placement since the paper's focus is ASCC3, not NR2C2. No COVID-19-specific citation exists for any of the four carrying factors in the retrieved material.
how_to_falsify: Knock down ZNF165, TGIF1 or TGFB1I1 in a rectal/colorectal cancer cell line and check whether SMAD7, SMURF2 and PMEPA1 expression and TGF-β-reporter output actually move; separately, in COVID-19 patient-derived lung epithelial or fibroblast cultures, check whether TGFB1I1 knockdown blunts TGF-β-driven fibrotic genes (CCN2, SERPINE1, COL1A1) after viral challenge. If neither perturbation moves the predicted targets, the shared TGF-β negative-feedback axis proposed here does not hold.
caveats: Support ranges 30-38 of 80 patient-group comparisons across 6 independent cohort pairs — moderate and consistent, but well short of unanimous. Tissue pairing is blood (COVID-19) versus colorectal (rectal cancer), so any shared axis must work through cell-intrinsic signalling logic rather than shared tissue context. The single-view exclusions (RFX1, GLIS3, RBCK1, ARID1A, etc.) were chromatin/immune factors that could have tempted a generic 'immune dysregulation' story; they are correctly absent here since they only topped one patient group. Among tissue-generic exclusions, SMAD3 itself was removed as generic to these tissues — meaning the canonical Smad driver could not distinguish this pair, so the account necessarily rests on the feedback/adapter layer (TGIF1, ZNF165, TGFB1I1, NR2C2) rather than core Smads.
